entries.305ad94fc72b202c: A business that manufactures and sells golf-related products, barrier rods, arrows and bows (for Western archery), and pole vault poles. Consolidated subsidiaries UST Mamiya Japan Co., Ltd. and UST-Mamiya, Inc. develop, manufacture and sell the products, and Mamiya-OP (Bangladesh) Ltd. manufactures the products. The main product is the golf shaft 'LIN-Q'. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,703 million.
entries.50aa287c6978f6f8: Golf club manufacturers and other golf equipment customers
entries.5e8e3a6d3a69e8f3: Lessees and purchasers of real estate
entries.90e7e397d7ade600: Amusement facilities such as gaming halls (pachinko parlors)
entries.dfb0086a32cb8f96: A manufacturer whose main business is electronic equipment, including equipment related to gaming machines, and which also manufactures and sells sporting goods such as golf shafts and operates a real estate business.
entries.ed7f24f4fad180f8: A business engaged in the buying and selling, leasing, brokerage and management of real estate. It is mainly conducted by consolidated subsidiaries Mamiya Estate Co., Ltd. and Nekuosu Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥237 million.
entries.f27e78d3a027939a: This is the company's core business, engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of gaming-related equipment, compact automatic ticket vending machines, banknote transport systems, banknote recognition devices, autonomous driving systems and others, as well as the installation and maintenance of gaming systems and the development and maintenance of software. The company develops and manufactures its products, and the company and its consolidated subsidiary Efu Esu Co., Ltd. sell them. Efu Esu Co., Ltd. also provides support and maintenance for systems for gaming halls and others. Mamiya IT Solutions Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary, conducts general operations related to system development. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥15,952 million.
